concept: Review and integration: sustained, active citizenship as a lifelong practice
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across civic engagement, civil discourse, and community contribution — what's your personal throughline as a citizen?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what citizenship means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
